data.description:
About the Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team.

Team Optimize turns decision history into better decisions. We build the systems customers use to evaluate, monitor and improve their decision flows and agents.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll build the backend systems and APIs behind them. Your work directly moves approval rates, false positive rates, and how confidently customers ship changes.

At scale, the systems you build will:

  • Process millions of decisions per day

  • Persist and query terabytes of data per day

  • Execute large-scale experiments over billions of historical decisions

  • Power agentic features such as natural-language analytics and automated optimization of flows and agents (Taktile AI)

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python / FastAPI on AWS serverless infrastructure.

  • Contribute to the design of high-scale subsystems operating on historical decision data, and deliver features end-to-end, from implementation and testing to deployment and monitoring

  • Write well-tested, reliable code and contribute to code reviews

  • Work with Product and senior engineers to turn business problems into well-scoped technical work

  • Operate in a high-leverage environment where AI-assisted and agentic coding are embedded into daily workflows, with access to state-of-the-art coding models (e.g., Claude Code) and the autonomy to use them deeply while maintaining strong engineering standards.

Requirements

  • 3+ years building production backend systems, with experience delivering moderately complex projects or features.

  • Comfort working with large datasets.

  • Prior industry experience with Python.

  • Experience with a major cloud provider, AWS preferred.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Location: Berlin (hybrid setup). Taktile will not cover relocation services for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Experience with building AI native applications

  • Experience with large-scale data technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Athena, Spark, or similar.

  • Experience with AWS serverless architectures (Lambda, SAM, Step Functions).

  • Familiarity with system design concepts and architectural trade-offs.

  • Experience with React and TypeScript.

  • Exposure to fraud, AML, risk, or financial decisioning domains.

What we offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About us

Taktile is building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is already making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

Taktile is based in Berlin, London and New York City. It was founded by machine learning and data science veterans with extensive experience building and running production ML in financial services. Our team consists of engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers with a diverse set of backgrounds. Some of us attended top universities such as Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford and some of us have no degree at all. We have accumulated extensive work experience at leading tech companies, startups, and the enterprise software sphere.

Our backers include Y Combinator, Index Ventures, and stellar angels such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog and UiPath.

 

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung.   • Administrative und organisatorische Aufgaben im Finance Operations übernimmst Du gemeinsam mit dem zuständigen Team.

data.description:
Who we are

The Company

CLARK UK is a high-growth Insurtech company which is part of the pan-European Insurtech group, CLARK. The company aims to improve how protection is handled and has a lively, friendly team that is dedicated to protecting individuals and families. The company culture blends innovation and high performance with a fun work environment.

The Opportunity

To support CLARK UK to satisfy its FCA regulatory requirements. Focussing on quality and efficiency, you will be involved in key areas of the compliance, quality assurance, and customer operations functions.

Focussing on good customer outcomes, you will work with the Head of Compliance & Customer Outcomes and relevant interdepartmental stakeholders to enhance, implement, and maintain these areas. This role is intentionally broad and agile, flexing across Financial Promotions, Quality Assurance (QA), and Customer Complaints / Resolutions based on immediate operational volume and business need.

Please note that this is a temporary role, offered on a fixed-term contract to cover a period of maternity leave. The expected duration and end date of the contract will be confirmed in your contract of employment.

Your tasks

1. Financial Promotions

  • Conduct compliance reviews and approvals of marketing campaigns, customer communications, web pages, and app screens in line with FCA rules, Consumer Duty, and internal SLA timelines.
  • Liaise with marketing and commercial teams to coordinate the re-approval of expiring promotions and maintain the centralised review tracker.
  • Perform periodic and annual compliance reviews across digital channels and public-facing content.

2. Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Perform regular QA call and interaction monitoring (including Demodesk sessions) to evaluate regulatory compliance, process adherence, and customer outcomes.
  • Identify training needs, operational weaknesses, and knowledge gaps through data analysis and calibration sessions.
  • Provide clear, constructive feedback and contribute to monthly QA insight packs for operational managers.
  • Support targeted quality review campaigns and internal audits focused on specific customer risks.

3. Customer Complaints & Resolutions

  • Investigate and resolve day-to-day and escalated customer complaints in accordance with FCA DISP rules and internal timescales.
  • Deliver fair, empathetic customer resolutions, collaborating across Operations, Underwriting, and Legal to gather evidence.
  • Monitor and respond to customer feedback on public review platforms (e.g. Trustpilot), identifying root causes and non-disclosures to prevent recurring issues.

4. Governance & Operational Support

  • Assist with compliance policy updates, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and centralised CPD/training record keeping.
  • Escalate emerging risks, conduct concerns, or regulatory breaches promptly to the Head of Compliance.
  • Provide flexible ad hoc operational and administrative support across Customer Operations as volume dictates.

What you bring

  • Industry Background: Experience in UK regulated financial services (insurance or consumer credit preferred).
  • Multi-Skilled Exposure: Practical familiarity with financial promotions reviews, QA monitoring, and/or complaint handling.
  • Regulatory Understanding: Working knowledge of FCA rules, including the Conduct Rules, Consumer Duty, and DISP.
  • Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Strong eye for detail with the ability to identify patterns, evaluate risk, and extract root-cause insights.
  • Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills with experience delivering constructive feedback and balanced customer letters.
  • Agility & Proactivity: High flexibility to pivot between compliance, quality, and operational tasks as business needs shift.

Regulatory Compliance and Conduct Expectations

Accountability for maintaining a compliant culture is shared across all levels of the organisation. Your role contributes directly to ensuring that we operate within the regulatory framework set out by the FCA and all employees are expected to understand and adhere to the company’s regulated responsibilities.

This includes:

  • Acting with honesty, integrity, with due skill and diligence, in accordance with the FCA’s Conduct Rules.
  • Carrying out your role in a manner that supports the company’s compliance with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Escalating any concerns or potential breaches of regulatory requirements to the appropriate line manager or compliance team without delay. (efficiency)
  • Completing mandatory compliance training, including maintaining a CPD record and remaining up to date with any changes in regulatory requirements relevant to your role. (growth)

Your Benefits - Why CLARK

  • 24 Days of Annual Leave
  • 1 Wellbeing Day
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Death in Service
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Perkbox

and more!

Why CLARK? Because YOU matter here
What makes us special: at CLARK, you can simply be yourself. Our dress code? Come as you are! Because diversity and equal opportunity are more than just words to us – they shape our daily work.
In other words: no matter where you come from or how you tick, as a CLARKee, you’ll experience an open work environment where you can realize your potential, share your ideas, and truly make an impact.
Sounds like your kind of place? Then we’re looking forward to meeting you!

data.description:
Senior Talent Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000

Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire.

We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with.

Why this role exists now

Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace.

We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position.

The role

You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls.

Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer.

  • Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities.

  • Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline candidates, and coaching hiring managers through the process.

  • Keeping candidates warm and informed through long, multi-stage processes, so no one ever goes dark.

  • Using AI, approved templates and Ashby automations to keep routine work fast, so switching between roles doesn't slow you down.

  • Building repeatable AI-assisted approaches (sourcing prompts, interview kits, funnel views) and sharing the useful ones with the team.

     
 

Who we're looking for

  • An experienced recruiter with deep, reliable expertise across the full recruitment lifecycle, and the curiosity to get up to speed quickly on any part of the business.

  • Experience recruiting across a wide range of functions at once, and switching context between very different roles without losing pace or quality.

  • Strong stakeholder partnering: you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, and have the credibility to influence and constructively challenge them with evidence, in writing and in the room, including pushing back on a brief without damaging the relationship.

  • Confident, consistent judgement of candidates whilst operating at pace. If you've worked through a period of growth you will feel right at home here.

  • An AI-native mindset: you don't just use AI tools, you re-engineer your own workflows with them, and you know where AI can be trusted and where judgement needs to take over.

  • Someone who shares what they know and helps develop the people around them.

 

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

  • If you want to specialise in one area. You'll be hiring across the whole organisation, often for very different roles in the same week. If you'd rather go deep in one function, this isn't the role for you.

  • If you want to move into people management now. This is an individual contributor role and you'll be carrying your own reqs. You'll informally mentor and share knowledge, but there are no direct reports.

  • If you're looking to own TA strategy or set standards for the whole team. Good ideas come from everyone in our team, but leading on this won’t be yours to own.

  • If you prefer a steer on ambiguous searches. We need someone who works through unclear briefs independently, and only escalates the genuinely strategic calls.

  • If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

  • If you're a brilliant solo recruiter but you don't share what works. Evidence of knowledge sharing from prior roles will be assessed during the interview process.

If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£50,000 - £60,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = 60-minute video call with our Talent Lead > In-person interview with two members of the People team > Final interview with two members of our SLT.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

 

How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

Compensation: £50K – £60K

data.title: Editor, International
data.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

About the role:
 We’re seeking an International Editor to tell Substack’s story across international markets on our owned channels. Together with Substack’s country leads, you will help build a bank of compelling editorial resources for our publishers, and you’ll shape and scale our brand storytelling around the world. This means crafting the strategy for how we tackle editorial needs market by market. You’ll work with translators and local agencies, all while protecting a cohesive Substack brand voice, identity, and quality bar.

The ideal candidate is passionate about writing, visual storytelling, and Substack’s mission. They are committed to profiling creators and publishers across the ideological spectrum, quick to grasp complex product storytelling, and excited to help build processes and strategy from scratch. They have demonstrable experience commissioning work that has captured the zeitgeist and enriched culture, and have worked with a range of creatives across disciplines. Ideally, they have also built or expanded an editorial function at a previous organisation.

This role is based in London, and reports to the Editorial Lead, with a dotted line to the Head of International.

Responsibilities:

  • Create an international storytelling strategy. Build our storytelling surfaces that hero our international creators, drive awareness to new global audiences, and enable our international partnerships team to recruit and retain publishers.

  • Manage translators and agencies. Drive forward briefs, and oversee translators and agencies as needed to support our key international markets at scale.

  • Collaborate across functions. Partner with Editorial, Comms, Partnerships, and country leads to make sure international editorial work is joined up with the rest of Substack’s communications and brand strategy.

  • Protect brand voice and quality. Ensure a cohesive brand voice, identity, and quality bar across every market and every translated or localized piece of content, however many hands it passes through.

Requirements:

  • Editorial judgment. You have a keen editorial eye and can judge, quickly and confidently, what’s worth translating and localizing for an international audience.

  • Exceptional project management. You can run multiple editorial workstreams across several markets at once, keeping translators, agencies, and internal stakeholders on schedule.

  • A writer at heart. You are an excellent writer and communicator, with an eye for what makes a compelling narrative.

  • Social media strategy. You have a strong eye for social media strategy and know what works on LinkedIn and how to repurpose for Instagram.

  • Cross-functional relationship-builder. You’ll cultivate strong working relationships with Editorial, Comms, and heads of markets, and you’re comfortable prioritising competing requests from several stakeholders at once across time zones.

  • Builder’s mindset. You’re comfortable building something (a hub, a process, a workflow) from scratch, and iterating on it as international needs evolve.

  • Cultural fluency. You’re familiar with Substack as a creator or subscriber and excited to help champion our mission internationally.

  • International experience. You’ve worked across international markets before, ideally in media, publishing, or communications, and understand the nuance of adapting content and brand voice for different cultural contexts.

Substack’s compensation package includes a market-competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is £70,000 - £100,000. Multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, determine final offer amounts and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

data.title: Technical Product Manager
data.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

You’ll own the product roadmap for Dex. That covers our candidate product, our client product, our internal tools and the ML systems behind all of them.

Our team moves fast. Your job is to point that speed at the right problems and keep a clear lookahead: what’s next, and what’s coming over the horizon.

Ideas at Dex come from design, engineering, our talent team, clients and candidates. You’ll pull them together, decide what matters most, and turn that into a plan we can deliver.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our founder, as well as across the whole business.

The divide between product managers and engineers has never been thinner, you’re excited by how AI is changing our roles and are excited to be part of how the products of the future are built.

You’re AI pilled, you run agents, you tinker and are excited about technology in general

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap. Our candidate product, client product, internal tools and the ML systems that power them are all connected. You'll own how they move forward together.

  • Partner with engineering and design. Work closely with our engineers and designers as the work gets done, from scoping through to shipping.

  • Build for our talent experts. Our internal talent experts are at the core of our business. Work alongside them to build a platform that makes them better at what they do.

  • Run delivery. Own our planning sessions and our roadmap in Linear. Make sure we have a plan, even if it might change, so we always know what’s next and roughly what’s after.

  • Do the analysis. Understand what we stand to gain from each piece of work in terms of metrics, set the hypothesis upfront, and work with the people doing the work to confirm or reject it.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong technical PM. You've worked in product at an early-stage company, and you were likely an engineer before that.

  • Delivery focused. You care deeply about moving fast and shipping.

  • Great with stakeholders. You're comfortable with candidates, clients and our internal recruitment team, and you keep all three at the heart of what gets built.

  • Use data, but aren't beholden to it. You make data-driven decisions where you can, and you're not afraid to make the call when the data isn’t there.

  • Bring consistency and rhythm. You help give the team a rhythm for how we plan and ship, so everyone knows what’s happening and when.

  • Forward thinking with AI. You're all in on AI, you build with it and you tinker in your own time.

Nice to Have

  • ML systems experience, especially recommendation, search or matchmaking

  • Marketplace experience

  • RecTech or HRTech experience

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

Interview Process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

data.title: Graduate Tax Analyst
data.description:
Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.

No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.

What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.

And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

 

The Job

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.

  • Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

  • Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

  • Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

  • Ship tools people use: build tax tools on live financial data, from first idea to everyday use.

  • Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve.

data.description:
Title: Site Associate 

Location: Glasgow

Pay: £13.25 per hour 

Part-time; (10 hours per week)

 

About Deliveroo Editions

With a dash of hard-work, a sprinkle of teamwork and a whole dollop of creativity, we created “Editions” which is our ‘dark kitchens’ business. We have partnered with some fantastic restaurants such as Wagamama, Starbucks, Pho and Gourmet Burger Company to help further connect them with hungry customers. 

Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. Deliveroo Editions were the world's first delivery-only kitchens, and we are still the market leaders in helping our restaurant partners succeed. What’s even more exciting is that we’re expanding our portfolio further.

Great people help to drive our business forward and we are always looking for more to join our sites. If you don’t have the exact experience, that’s okay, we’d still love to hear from you. 

Does this sound tasty to you? Take a look at our Kitchen Assistant role and apply below to join the Roo family.

About the role

The Cleaner / Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners. 

Responsibilities will include:

  • You will report into the Site Manager and the site management team.

  • Ensuring that the cleanliness of the site is maintained to a high standard by cleaning as you go throughout the shift as well as regular deep cleaning of various equipment throughout the week

  • Cleaning communal areas, such as staff room, bathrooms, stock rooms, maintaining site health and safety standards at all times

  • Working with the management team to ensure a safe and clean site by participating in regularly checking

  • Supporting our partners by keeping kitchen equipment clean and ready for use throughout the shift with the pot wash

Who we are looking for

  • You radiate positivity!

  • You have a great attitude to work, you are driven and have willingness to learn

  • You are a team player, punctuality and reliability is your forte

  • You always go above and beyond, you’re looking to progress in your career

  • You can work autonomously but you LOVE working with a fantastic team and with our partners

  • You like to solve problems, making recommendations on how to improve daily tasks

  • Previous experience in a Kitchen Porter or Kitchen Cleaner role is a bonus, but don’t worry if you haven’t, if you have the right attitude and drive, we can train you.

What to expect from the interview process

  • Step 1: apply for any role you'd like to be considered for - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Step 2: if your application is successful, you will receive an assessment from Maki People

  • Step 3: if you're successful following assessment, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

  • Step 4: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

  • Step 5: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

Why Deliveroo


Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. . We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace and Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

data.title: Warehouse Supervisor
data.description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Brighton - St Josephs Business Park (BN3)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Brighton team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.  

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role:

As a Member Experience Associate at Industrious, you will be the heart of the member experience, truly aiming to create great days for all who enter your office. While your day may not look the same, here's what it could look like: 

  • You are the first face people see while you’re preparing the office for the day: brewing coffee, setting out breakfast, and stocking shared amenities. 

  • You’re proactive and take ownership over managing inventory and ordering your location’s supplies.

  • You build magnificent events and take the extra time to design unique signage because you know the magic is in the details.

You know that the most meaningful interactions are rooted in trust and shared values.

We are Industrious.

We’re building a team of considerate collaborators who create great days. Come join us.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

The salary for this role is £29,000 + performance bonus.

On top of that, you'll enjoy a range of perks, including private healthcare, pension, Employee Assistance Programme, corporate events, Learning & Development Grant, regular training.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the role

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. You will extend our existing TypeScript mobile test framework and help build quality in earlier, working alongside engineers in a collaborative team that wants to shift left. You’ll get coaching, mentoring and support from our Staff Quality Engineer.

What you’ll do

  • Hands-on functional, acceptance and planned, risk-based exploratory testing of our native iOS and Android apps

  • Be instrumental in the implementation of mobile tests that support the CI/CD pipeline for the software stacks and frameworks we support (TS, XCode, WebdriverIO)

  • Work with the Staff QE to ensure the rollout and socialisation of proactive quality information, plans and reports to project teams, enabling them to make better decisions around processes, solutions and releases

  • Advocate for, coach and educate project teams on the contextual use of testing techniques that allow us to embed shift-left and shift-right testing practices

  • Bring a quality lens to ideas before they’re built, working with engineers, product and design (e.g. Three Amigos)

data.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team


Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

As a Senior Manager within our Public Services team, you’ll lead critical work for discerning and highly AI literate customers in the UK Government and for international partners. This is a fast paced and demanding role which, in addition to mission area context, requires programme delivery mastery and an ability to think thoughtfully and creatively about the role for AI in the core public services we utilise on a daily basis.

 

You can expect to lead portfolios of work for our customers, which range from experimental applications of emerging technologies, to products that we progress through a complete development lifecycle and deploy for users in Government.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Managing the delivery of multiple, complex programmes of work for our Public Services clients including strategy, R&D, and product builds.

  • Overseeing a portfolio of projects across multiple facets of the Public Services including the Home Office, Department for Education and others.

  • Developing and owning compelling proposals to grow our Public Sector portfolio.

  • Mentoring and developing team members, aligning their responsibilities with the critically important Public Services work for which we’re responsible.

  • Working strategically to deliver meaningful outcomes for public sector organisations rather than just focusing on outputs.

  • Forming strong, trusted relationships with senior government customers and collaborating closely with other consulting partners where needed

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, engaging confidently in technical discussions with directors.

  • Supporting wider business efforts as a Senior Manager to ensure maximum strategic flexibility and commercial impact.

     

Who we're looking for:

 
 

  • You bring a strong background in leading complex, large-scale transformation programs within the Public Services domain

  • You have a proven track record of delivering GDS-style digital products and operationalising AI-enabled services in Government

  • You demonstrate experience across Government, academia, or industry, with a deep understanding of public sector needs

  • You show a genuine passion for AI and ML, with the creativity to translate these concepts into real-world applications

  • You understand commercial consulting models and excel at driving account growth and project oversight

  • You apply a structured, thoughtful approach to problem-solving to consistently deliver high-quality work on critical projects

     

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Legal Solutions Engineer

Edinburgh
London

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

Legal Solutions Engineers turn the product into real outcomes for customers.

You’ll work with customers after purchase to design, configure, and implement legal workflows inside Wordsmith. This role sits close to the customer, helping them embed the platform into how their legal function actually operates.

It’s part implementation, part problem solving, and part advisory. You’ll combine legal understanding with product knowledge to help customers get meaningful value from the platform.

data.description:
We're looking for an exceptional AI-native operator to join Smartly as Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation, working directly with our Chief People Officer.

Smartly is a global technology company at the intersection of AI, advertising, and creativity. As AI transforms how businesses operate, we're rethinking how we organize work, build capabilities, and unlock productivity across our global organization.This is an opportunity to be at the center of that transformation.

You'll help drive some of our most important strategic initiatives—from launching new R&D centers globally to building an entirely new approach to workforce planning. You'll create the operating rhythm that keeps our People leadership team aligned, accountable, and moving forward. And you'll build AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that connect information, automate processes, and help us make better decisions.

We're looking for a builder, not just a coordinator.

You're the kind of person who sees a messy problem, builds a plan, gets the right people moving, and then asks how AI could make the whole process 10x better.

What You'll Do

Drive high-impact transformation projects

  • Own the execution of strategic, cross-functional initiatives, including global expansion, workforce planning, organizational transformation, and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Translate ambitious priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability.
  • Bring senior stakeholders together, unblock decisions, and ensure important initiatives move forward with urgency and discipline.

Build AI-powered tools and operating systems

  • Design and build AI agents, automations, and workflows that make our People organization more effective.
  • Develop tools that connect People data with Finance, Operations, and business performance metrics to improve visibility into organizational effectiveness and transformation outcomes.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies, prototype new solutions, and turn successful experiments into scalable workflows.
  • Partner with technical and analytics teams to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and useful.

Be the operational engine of our People leadership team

  • Establish a consistent cadence of planning, reporting, project reviews, and accountability across our global People organization.
  • Create dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into strategic priorities, progress, risks, and decisions.
  • Own the preparation of quarterly People business reviews for our CEO, turning complex information into sharp insights and compelling executive presentations.
  • Help our Chief People Officer and leadership team stay focused on the work that matters most.

Who You Are

  • An AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools—you've built agents, automations, or workflows that solve real problems. You're constantly experimenting with what's new.
  • An exceptional operator. You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and relentless about follow-through. Nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Entrepreneurial and resourceful. You thrive in fast-moving environments, figure things out independently, and love building from scratch.
  • Confident and people-oriented. You enjoy meeting people, asking questions, and engaging senior leaders. You're comfortable pushing for clarity and accountability.
  • Analytical and articulate. You can turn messy information into clear thinking, compelling presentations, and actionable recommendations.

You likely have 2–5 years of experience in a high-growth startup, founder's office, strategy and operations, consulting, product operations, or a similarly demanding environment.You don't need an HR background or a traditional Chief of Staff title. We're far more interested in what you've built, how you think, and what you're capable of becoming.

Why This Role?

  • You'll work directly with the Chief People Officer on initiatives that shape how a global technology company operates.
  • You'll gain exposure to executive decision-making, international expansion, organizational strategy, AI transformation, and the future of work—while taking real ownership from day one.

If you're ambitious, love solving hard problems, and want to help build the operating model of an AI-native company, we'd love to hear from you.

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. data.title: Software Engineer (C++/C#)
data.description:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG.

We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our core engineering team. You'll be responsible for implementing and maintaining our C# client library, and also working alongside our core engineering team on the most performance-sensitive parts of our codebase.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain our C# client library, ensuring it is robust, well-tested, and easy for external users to integrate with.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance server applications in C++.
  • Write message parsers and feed handlers for direct market data feeds from trading venues.
  • Optimize existing codebase for high throughput (millions of messages per second, up to 40+ gigabits) and low latency (measured in nanoseconds).
  • Implement tools and libraries for petabyte-scale data processing and analysis.
  • Collaborate with the systems team to implement best practices for build, deployment, CI/CD.
  • Implement monitoring and improve application uptime.
  • Ensure smooth feature rollouts and updates.

Preferred background

  • 5+ years of full-time software engineering experience, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup.
  • Strong proficiency in both C++ and C#.
  • Experience with Java is a plus.
  • Experience designing APIs with a strong focus on intuitive, developer-friendly interfaces.
  • Familiarity with open source best practices, including release management, versioning, changelogs, issue triage, and backwards compatibility.
  • Knowledge of systems programming, algorithms, data structures, multithreading, networked I/O, serialization, CPU architecture, kernel, and compilers.
  • Experience working with multiprocess environments.
  • Comfortable with lldb/gdb.
  • Good communication skills and work ethic for a remote workplace.
  • An interest in low-level optimization and performance engineering.
  • An interest in financial data or algorithmic trading.

We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$250,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role.

Notice about phishing scams

Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). Any other domains (e.g., databento-careers.com, databento.online) are fraudulent.

🦊 À propos de Green-Got :

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle : c’est le socle de notre crédibilité vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) + Télétravail partiel Contrat : Alternance Niveau : Master 1 Poste à pourvoir : Janvier - Février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

La transition écologique est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance rend cette mission crédible et durable.

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Production et gestion des dossiers Compliance (80 %)

  • Traitement des dossiers KYC et de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses les dossiers, vérifies la cohérence des informations et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus.

  • Vigilance sur les flux et les alertes : tu qualifies les alertes, identifies les situations à risque et proposes les mesures à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

  • Traçabilité : chaque action est documentée. Dans un environnement réglementé, ce qui n’est pas tracé n’a pas été fait.

Outils et amélioration continue (20 %)

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : tu utilises Notion au quotidien pour documenter, suivre et partager le travail de l’équipe. C’est un outil central de notre fonctionnement que tu dois maîtriser rapidement.

  • Automatisation : tu repères les tâches répétitives et proposes des solutions pour les réduire, en lien avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Veille et documentation : tu suis les évolutions réglementaires et contribues à maintenir nos procédures à jour.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et contribuer aux projets de l’équipe.

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous : quelqu’un de passionné par les enjeux réglementaires et par les sujets data et IA, qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

  • Maturité et autonomie : tu avances sans attendre qu’on te guide pas à pas. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu proposes des solutions et tu prends en charge tes sujets jusqu’au bout.

  • Sens de l’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues.

data.title: Compliance Data & IA Specialist - Alternance
data.description:
🦊 À propos de Green-Got

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements financiers pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition (assurance-vie, produits structurés, PER, Private Equity).

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle. C’est le socle de notre crédibilité, vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) · Présence au bureau : minimum 4 jours par semaine · Contrat : Alternance de 24 mois · Niveau : Master 1 · Poste à pourvoir : janvier ou février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique et un levier de croissance durable. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Ce poste s’adresse à une personne curieuse et engagée, qui veut appliquer ses compétences techniques à des sujets de conformité qui comptent vraiment.

Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

Chez Green-Got, la transition écologique n’est pas un sujet annexe. C’est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance est ce qui rend cette mission crédible et durable. En rejoignant l’équipe, tu rejoins une entreprise dont le cœur de métier est là.

Tes missions

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Opérations et gestion des dossiers Compliance (60 %)

  • Garant de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses la cohérence des dossiers KYC et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus des membres.

  • Contrôle et vigilance des flux : tu suis les transactions, qualifies les alertes et proposes les mesures conservatoires à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

IA appliquée, réglementation et formation (40 %)

  • Réglementation IA (AI Act) : tu maîtrises les obligations du règlement européen sur l’intelligence artificielle et tu es responsable de leur mise en place au sein de la Compliance (et tout Green-Got). Cela inclut l’inventaire de nos usages IA, leur classification par niveau de risque, la documentation et les contrôles associés.

  • Contribution au cerveau de Green-Got : tu participes à la construction et à l’alimentation de la base de connaissance partagée de l’entreprise, pour que les équipes et les outils IA s’appuient sur les mêmes informations, procédures et règles.

  • Applications internes : tu repères les process de la Compliance qui gagneraient à être outillés, puis tu participes à la conception de ces applications avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Skills Library : tu formalises les méthodes de travail de l’équipe (analyse de dossiers, rédaction de rapports, contrôles) sous forme de compétences réutilisables par les équipes et les agents IA, et tu les tiens à jour à chaque évolution de notre offre.

  • Assistants et agents IA : tu participes à leur paramétrage et à leur amélioration, et tu mesures leur fiabilité avant toute mise en production.

  • Formation de l’équipe : tu es le relais IA de la Compliance. Tu accompagnes tes collègues sur les outils et les bons usages, tu partages tes méthodes et tu aides chacun à monter en compétences, à son rythme.

  • Veille et expérimentation : tu explores les nouveaux usages de l’IA dans un cadre maîtrisé et tu partages tes conclusions avec l’équipe.

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : Notion est au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Tu le maîtrises et tu contribues à le faire évoluer pour l’équipe.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production, pour bien comprendre nos process avant de les automatiser. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et monter en puissance sur les projets Data & IA et sur la réglementation IA.

Vos compétences

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous. Quelqu’un qui a une véritable passion pour la data, la tech et les enjeux réglementaires, et qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu.

  • Esprit analytique et algorithmique : tu allies une solide culture data (SQL, manipulation de bases de données, intérêt pour les LLM et le prompt engineering) à un esprit d’analyse affûté pour décortiquer les dossiers complexes, qualifier les alertes et détecter les comportements à risque.

Avantages

data.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

At Yubo, Platform Engineering plays a key role in keeping our product reliable and scalable for millions of users, while supporting new technical challenges, including AI.

We're looking for an SRE Platform Manager to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael, our Platform Engineering Director.

You'll lead 6 experienced DevOps/SRE and Backend Platform Engineers, including Staff Engineers and an Infrastructure Tech Lead. Your mission? Ensure platform reliability, improve delivery performance, and help your team grow while preserving their technical autonomy.

You'll also contribute to building the infrastructure needed to deploy AI agents in production, working closely with Security and AI Enablement.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong hands-on SRE/DevOps experience with people leadership, and enjoys balancing technical challenges, operational excellence, and team development.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of 6 DevOps/SRE and Backend Platform Engineers

  • Own platform reliability (SLOs, SLIs, monitoring, incident management and on-call)

  • Partner with Staff Engineers to turn technical decisions into actionable plans

  • Drive the infrastructure needed to deploy AI agents in production alongside Security and AI Enablement

  • Monitor cloud costs and drive optimization initiatives

  • Track DORA metrics to improve delivery performance and team efficiency

  • Balance operational needs, technical improvements, and strategic initiatives

  • Foster collaboration across Backend, Data, ML, and Security teams

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Role

We're looking for an FP&A to join our Finance team. In this role, you'll act as the key financial partner to business leaders, driving performance analysis, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making across the organisation.

  • Serve as the go-to financial partner for brand directors, production studios and commercial teams, tracking profitability per operation and supporting pricing and go/no-go decisions

  • Build the annual budget and quarterly reforecasts with operational teams, and maintain the multi-year business plan and its scenarios

  • Support the CFO in managing the 13-week and monthly cash flow forecast, monitoring working capital and customer collection KPIs

  • Maintain and evolve the Group's dashboards and reporting for management, board and shareholders - from audience and monetisation metrics to margin, cash and unit economics

  • Strengthen and automate the financial data chain (ERP, treasury tools, production tracking, platform data) and lead data and automation projects to reduce manual workloads

  • Structure a financial data governance framework (definitions, data quality, single source of truth, access management) and enforce robust operational controls

  • Contribute to the evolution of budgeting tools and processes (workflow, calendar, contributor governance) and lead the build-out of priority Finance BI dashboards

  • Drive the deployment of AI agents to replace manual processes and improve the operational efficiency of the Finance team

  • Contribute to M&A and integration projects (modelling, due diligence, synergies, 100-day plans) and ad hoc analyses requested by senior management

  • 5 to 7+ years of experience in Finance, ideally combining a Big Four audit or Transaction Services background with hands-on FP&A, management control or Finance Data/Systems experience in a multi-entity, scale-up or high-growth environment

  • Degree from a top business or engineering school, or a Master's in Finance / CCA / DSCG or equivalent

  • Strong financial modelling skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets; comfortable with ERP systems (Odoo a plus), EPM tools and BI platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI or equivalent)
